Metadata.title: SMM Panel — Social Media Marketing Orders
Metadata.description: Order Telegram, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other social media marketing services from one secure dashboard, or straight from our Telegram bot.

Home.heroTitle: One dashboard for all your social media marketing orders
Home.heroSubtitle: Place orders across Telegram, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and more, track progress, top up your wallet, and get support — all from a secure, production-grade panel, or straight from our Telegram bot.
Home.pricingSubtitle: Pulled directly from our current catalog — no account required to browse.
Home.feature1Desc: Order Telegram, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other services from a single catalog, organized by platform.
Home.feature2Desc: Hardened auth with account lockout, rate limiting, encrypted provider credentials, and an audit log for sensitive actions.
Home.feature3Desc: Every balance change is an immutable ledger entry — deposit, order, and refund history you can always review.
Home.feature4Desc: Watch every order move from pending to processing to completed, with automatic retry on transient fulfillment errors.
Home.feature5Desc: Link your account and place orders, submit deposits, or open support tickets straight from Telegram — the exact same logic as the website.
Home.feature6Desc: A ticketing system with admin replies, reachable from the dashboard or the bot.
Home.faq1A: Services are organized by platform group in our catalog — currently including Telegram, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, with more added over time. Browse the full, live-priced list on our service catalog page before creating an account.
Home.faq2Q: Do I need to install anything?
Home.faq2A: No. Everything runs from your browser on the web dashboard. If you'd rather manage orders from your phone, you can also link your account to our Telegram bot and place orders, submit deposits, or reach support from there — it uses the exact same account and order history as the website.
Home.faq3Q: How does pricing and billing work?
Home.faq3A: You maintain a wallet balance. Top it up, then place orders — each order deducts its cost from your balance. Every balance change (deposits, orders, refunds) is recorded as a permanent, itemized transaction you can review at any time.
Home.faq4Q: What happens if an order fails?
Home.faq4A: Orders that hit a transient fulfillment error are automatically retried rather than silently marked as failed — a charged order is never quietly abandoned. If an order genuinely can't be completed, our support team handles refunds manually through the same wallet ledger.
Home.faq5A: Passwords are hashed (never stored in plain text), accounts lock temporarily after repeated failed login attempts, and sensitive provider-side credentials are encrypted at rest. We don't claim to be a bank-grade financial institution — we do apply standard, verifiable security practices throughout the platform.
Home.readySubtitle: Create a free account, top up your wallet, and place your first order in minutes.
